hooks.command: HOOK=''; d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != '/' ]; do if [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/langfuse_logger.py" ]; then HOOK="$d/.claude/hooks/langfuse_logger.py"; break; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -z "$HOOK" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.claude/hooks/langfuse_logger.py" ] && HOOK="$HOME/.claude/hooks/langfuse_logger.py"; [ -n "$HOOK" ] && uv run --no-project --with 'langfuse>=3.9' --with python-dotenv python "$HOOK" || true
